title: Update scores from two game events
careers: Game testers check that each player action updates the right counter on screen.
goal: I can update two score variables when the player touches a pickup or a hazard.

slides.title: Update scores from two game events
lines: I can add one point when the player touches a pickup.
I can add one hit when the player touches a hazard.
I can choose change blocks instead of set blocks.
I can save and test my maze project.
slides.cue: Choose one scoring event skill to practise today.
slides.notes: Introduce Week 2 of the GROW ICT Autumn 2 maze sequence for the unit award. All variable names and event rules come from fictional project cards A and B. Keep personal names, places and external account details out of the task.

slides.title: Our variable skills from last week
lines: Where did you save your Week 1 maze file?
Which two score variables did you create?
How do both variables reset to zero on start?
Open your Week 1 file or the clean starter file.
slides.cue: Show or explain how your start script resets both scores.
slides.notes: Retrieve the Week 1 file and check that both score variables reset to 0 on start. If a pupil's Week 1 file is absent, open the prepared Week 2 starter maze file with both variables and start resets ready.

slides.title: Why is Score A stuck at 1?
lines: Look at Script A and Script B. Which script adds points each time you touch a pickup?
slides.cue: Choose a script and explain why the score goes up.
slides.notes: Compare a pickup script that uses set FuelScore to 1 with one that uses change FuelScore by 1. Explain that set fixes the value at 1 every time, while change adds 1 to the current total.
answers: Script B works because change FuelScore by 1 adds one point to the current total.
Script A stays at 1 because set FuelScore to 1 overwrites the score instead of adding.

slides.title: Update the pickup variable on contact
lines: Check when the player touches the pickup sprite.
Change the pickup variable by 1 inside that check.
slides.cue: Point to the block that adds one pickup point.
slides.notes: Model adding a touching check for the pickup item in Card A. Place change FuelScore by 1 inside the touching check and make sure the variable drop-down selects FuelScore, not HazardHits.

slides.title: Update the hazard variable on contact
lines: Check when the player touches a hazard wall.
Change the hazard variable by 1 and return to start.
slides.cue: Point to the block that records a hazard hit.
slides.notes: Model the second event rule for Card A: when touching the hazard wall, change HazardHits by 1 and move the player back to the start pad so the hit is counted clearly.

slides.title: Words for scoring events
lines: event: a trigger that runs a rule in the game
touching: a check for contact between two sprites
change: add to or take away from a variable value
set: fix a variable to one exact value
slides.cue: Use one word to explain how a score goes up.
slides.notes: Teach the four words using the two event scripts on screen. Highlight the difference between set on start and change on contact.

slides.title: Match each event to its score block
lines: Touch fuel pod: change FuelScore by 1.
Touch hazard wall: change HazardHits by 1.
slides.cue: Match each maze contact to the right variable block.
slides.notes: Use Space maze card A. Match pickup contact to change FuelScore by 1 and hazard contact to change HazardHits by 1. Check that set-to-zero stays on the start event only.
answers: Pickup contact: when touching fuel pod, change FuelScore by 1.
Hazard contact: when touching hazard wall, change HazardHits by 1 and go to start pad.

slides.title: A partner tests both game events
lines: Touch the pickup and watch the pickup readout.
Touch the hazard and watch the hazard readout.
slides.cue: Give one fix if the wrong variable changes.
slides.notes: Model testing both events in turn: touch the pickup, check that FuelScore increases by 1, then touch the hazard wall and check that HazardHits increases by 1. Press start to verify both still reset to 0.
answers: Check the variable drop-down if touching a hazard changes the pickup score.
Replace set with change if a counter stays stuck at 1.

slides.title: Update scores from two events in your maze
lines: Supported: use the two-event scoring frame.
Independent: build and test both event score rules.
Aspire: add a finish bonus event and save v2.
Each person saves and checks their own project file.
slides.cue: Choose a route and build your two scoring events.
slides.notes: Slides 10-13 share this 12-minute task time. Each pupil updates their own maze file in ICT_Practice/W02_Events. A shared device uses six-minute turns: Card A then Card B, swapping builder and tester roles.

slides.title: Supported
lines: Open your maze file for card A or card B.
Add change pickup score by 1 to the pickup check.
Add change hazard hits by 1 to the hazard check.
Test both events with your partner.
Save, reopen and test the events again.
slides.cue: Show each score changing when you touch each item.
slides.notes: Use the Supported planning frame. Point to the two touching checks and let the pupil choose the variable name and change value. Record any prompts or exact scribing used.

slides.title: Independent
lines: Open your maze file for card A or card B.
Build the pickup contact rule to add 1 to the pickup score.
Build the hazard contact rule to add 1 to hazard hits.
Test pickup contact, hazard contact and start reset.
Save your file in W02_Events, then reopen it.
slides.cue: Ask your partner to test both scoring events.
slides.notes: The pupil builds both event rules using their project card and saves as Maze_Events_A_v1 or Maze_Events_B_v1 in ICT_Practice/W02_Events.

slides.title: Aspire
lines: Complete the Independent task first.
Add the finish gate bonus rule from your project card.
Change the pickup score by 5 when touching the finish.
Ask a partner to test all three scoring events.
Save a new v2 file and explain your change.
slides.cue: Show how the finish gate adds a bonus to your score.
slides.notes: Use the card's stretch rule to add a +5 finish bonus when touching the finish target. Save as Maze_Events_A_v2 or Maze_Events_B_v2 while keeping v1.

slides.title: My evidence record
lines: My file name is ...
My pickup event changes ... by ...
My hazard event changes ... by ...
I fixed or improved ... because ...
I reopened the saved file and tested both events.
slides.cue: Record your two event rules and the help used.
slides.notes: Observe the pickup score rule, the hazard hit rule, the distinction between change and set, and the reopened file check. Record actual support. Do not prefill pupil codes or tick boxes.

slides.title: How do events update our scores?
lines: Show your pickup event and your hazard event.
Explain why we use change by 1 instead of set to 1.
Open your saved file and test both events.
slides.cue: Show your two event rules and give one reason.
slides.notes: Three minutes for individual checks, two for feedback and close. Check the saved file in W02_Events. Week 3 stops a pickup counting more than once. Week 7 is the assessing lesson; this week is formative.

steps: Open your maze file. Check the start reset to 0.
When touching the pickup, change pickup score by 1.
When touching a hazard, change hazard hits by 1.
Test both events. Save and reopen your file.
words: A trigger that runs a rule in the game.
A check for contact between two sprites.
Add to or take away from a variable value.
Fix a variable to one exact value.
An item the player collects to gain points.
An obstacle that adds a hit and sends the player back.

sources.label: Source A
sources.title: A space maze project
join: Pickup event: touch fuel pod -> change FuelScore by 1.
Hazard event: touch laser wall -> change HazardHits by 1.
do: Return player to start pad after a hazard hit.
Keep set FuelScore to 0 and set HazardHits to 0 on start.
part: Check the variable drop-down on each change block.
Stretch event: touch finish gate -> change FuelScore by 5.

sources.label: Source B
sources.title: A deep-sea maze project
join: Pickup event: touch pearl shell -> change PearlScore by 1.
Hazard event: touch reef spike -> change ReefHits by 1.
do: Return player to start pad after a hazard hit.
Keep set PearlScore to 0 and set ReefHits to 0 on start.
part: Check the variable drop-down on each change block.
Stretch event: touch finish gate -> change PearlScore by 5.

Ask your partner to test pickup, hazard, finish and start reset.
